title: A 3D Cell Culture Model Identifies Wnt/β‐Catenin Mediated Inhibition of p53 as a Critical Step during Human Hepatocyte Regeneration

evidence_spans.quote: Here, a 3D spheroid model of PHH is established to study hepatocyte regeneration
human hepatocyte regeneration
proliferative senescence-inducing target PAI1
integrative time-lapse multi-omics analyses

scope_reviewer.uncertainty_reason: The abstract describes PAI1 only as a senescence-inducing target and reports regeneration/proliferation, without explicitly measuring, inducing, reversing, or comparing a senescent state. It also uses a generic multi-omics label without naming currently used molecular layers.
scope_reviewer.concise_rationale: This is a primary biological study in human hepatocytes. Aging relevance and multi-omics layers remain unresolved from the supplied abstract.

causal_design_reviewer.exposure_or_intervention: Activation of Wnt signaling through external cues
causal_design_reviewer.outcome: p53 and PAI1 inhibition and primary human hepatocyte proliferation
